_comment: Which Screenmate (stock) build each SM Dash release needs.
The in-app updater fetches this before offering an update, so it never pushes a release
whose patch cannot apply to the box — installing one leaves the dashboard in demo mode,
and Android blocks downgrading back. Add an entry in the SAME commit that bumps
Patcher.REQUIRED_STOCK_PREFIX, and push it BEFORE publishing the release.
Read over raw.githubusercontent.com: no auth, no API rate limit (the GitHub API's 60/h is
why the updater resolves the latest tag from the /releases/latest redirect instead).
EVERY published release needs an entry: a release missing here is never offered, because it
fails the compatibility filter AND leaves the 'what does the newest need?' lookup empty.
